description: This file contains functions and configurations for generating HTML pages for API documentation using Swagger UI and ReDoc in a FastAPI application. It includes functions to create HTML responses for Swagger UI, ReDoc, and OAuth2 redirect handling, along with default parameters and utility functions.

methods.name: _html_safe_json
methods.description: Serializes a value to JSON with HTML special characters escaped to prevent injection when embedded in HTML.

methods.name: get_swagger_ui_html
methods.description: Generates HTML for Swagger UI API documentation page with configurable parameters.

methods.name: get_redoc_html
methods.description: Generates HTML for ReDoc API documentation page with configurable parameters.

methods.name: get_swagger_ui_oauth2_redirect_html
methods.description: Generates HTML for OAuth2 redirect handling in Swagger UI.
